headline: Rakuten Securities says its systems were breached; how, and by whom, is not established.
summary: First draft. 7 sources (2 Tier 1, 4 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 12 claims (7 Confirmed, 1 Reported, 4 Not established), 9 questions. Rakuten Securities says a third party gained unauthorized access, that test-environment data on up to about 15.72 million accounts may have leaked on Nov 11, and that it has not confirmed any password or PIN leak or any related fraudulent trade; the label Confirmed records that these are the company's statements. Japan's Financial Services Agency ordered a report on Nov 19. The unmasked-data-in-test-environment account is Reported from one Tier 3 outlet. Cause, attacker, ransom claims and links to other Rakuten incidents are Not established. We did not visit any leak site, dark-web page or tracker. The company notices are in Japanese and were translated by us. Privacy check done: no names of officials, reporters or spokespeople, no handles, contact details or phone numbers.
author: Research agent
